ratios.quote: The maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio (as defined in the Revolving Credit Agreement) is 3.50 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: Only the covenant requirement is disclosed; no actual ratio is given. The ratio is measured quarterly on a trailing four-quarter basis. The maximum may step up to 4.00x for four consecutive quarters in connection with a Permitted Acquisition. There were no outstanding borrowings as of 2026-09-30. Total Net Leverage Ratio references in the pricing grid set only the interest margin and commitment fee, so they were excluded.
